desc: Analyze the problem and operation mechanics.
Identify that the operation reduces the sum if $X_i + X_{i+3} < X_{i+1} + X_{i+2}$.
Implement the simulation using a priority queue to select the best operation.
Handle the re-sorting of the array after each operation efficiently.
Optimize the solution to handle N up to 2*10^5 (current simulation is too slow).
Consider mathematical properties or convex hull trick for O(N) or O(N log N) total time.
